era: 晚清至民国初期 / Late Qing to early Republican China (1866-1925)
school: 革命建国/政治制度设计/经济纲领 / Revolutionary State-Building / Constitutional Design / Economic Programs
historical_significance: 中华民国国父、亚洲第一个共和国的奠基人。屡败屡起（十次起义失败而辛亥一朝功成），一生在流亡中完成三民主义、五权宪法、建国方略三套体系。核心方法论：以『知难行易』重置行动障碍（把不敢行诊断为不会知，再以学说破除畏难心理）、以革命程序论（军政-训政-宪政）把终极目标拆成有验收标准的过渡阶段、以平均地权四大纲领（规定地价/照价征税/涨价归公/照价收买）用申报-税制-收买闭环解决土地增值归属、以《实业计划》借国际剩余资本办国家基建、以权能区分与五权宪法修补代议制流弊、以民权初步把民主训练成可操演的会议规程。他是把宏大理想翻译成分期施工图、把政治信念制度化为可执行程序的转换器式人物。
historical_significance_en: Father of modern China and founder of Asia's first republic. Defeated ten times yet victorious at the eleventh, he spent a lifetime in exile building three interlocking systems: the Three Principles of the People, the Five-Power Constitution, and the Fundamentals of National Reconstruction. Core methodology: resetting the barrier to action with 'knowing is hard, doing is easy' (diagnosing the failure to act as a failure of knowledge, then dissolving the fear of action with doctrine); decomposing an ultimate goal into transitional stages with acceptance criteria (military rule, tutelage, constitutional government); solving land-value capture with a four-clause closed loop (declared value, taxed by value, unearned increment to the public, compulsory purchase at declared value); financing national infrastructure with international surplus capital in The International Development of China; repairing representative government's flaws via separation of powers (people's powers vs. government powers, five branches); and turning democracy into a rehearsed procedure with his Manual of Parliamentary Procedure. He was a converter-figure who translated grand ideals into phased construction blueprints and political conviction into executable institutional procedures.

cross_references.relation_type: 同为把理念制度化的建国者：孙中山造国家蓝图，涩泽造资本组织
cross_references.description_zh: 孙中山把宏大理想拆成分期施工的建国程序（M-SYS-002/M-SYS-010）；涩泽把儒家伦理组织成银行与股份公司（M-SBRY-002）。两人同处东亚近代化转型，都以『把理想翻译成可执行程序』为方法论核心，差异在政治工程与经济工程。
cross_references.description_en: Sun Yat-sen decomposed grand ideals into phased national-construction programs (M-SYS-002/M-SYS-010); Shibusawa organized Confucian ethics into banks and joint-stock companies (M-SBRY-002). Both faced East Asia's modernization transition and both translated ideals into executable procedures—one in political engineering, one in economic engineering.

cross_references.relation_type: 东亚启蒙的两种路径：文明论启蒙 vs 革命建国
cross_references.description_zh: 福泽以『一身独立而后一国独立』从人的独立出发设计文明（M-FYJ-002）；孙中山以革命程序与权能区分从国家制度出发训练民权（M-SYS-002/M-SYS-006）。两人同为东亚近代转型的设计师，路径互为镜像：福泽自下而上，孙中山自上而下。
cross_references.description_en: Fukuzawa designed civilization starting from the independent individual ('one person independent, then the nation independent', M-FYJ-002); Sun Yat-sen trained civil rights starting from state institutions via revolutionary stages and power separation (M-SYS-002/M-SYS-006). Both were designers of East Asia's modern transition on mirror-image paths: bottom-up versus top-down.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 福泽档案（H-FYJ-001）未来修订时可在『文明阶段位差』处补一条指向 H-SYS-001 的跨引用（自上而下的革命建国平行版本）。

cross_references.relation_type: 权力制度化的性别与路径对照
cross_references.description_zh: 武则天以个人权力运作改写制度（M-WZT 系列）；孙中山以制度设计约束并组织权力（M-SYS-005）。两者共同回答『权力如何被安排』，一个从既有体制内部操作，一个从蓝图外部重构。
cross_references.description_en: Wu Zetian rewrote institutions through the operation of personal power (M-WZT series); Sun Yat-sen organized and constrained power through institutional design (M-SYS-005). Both answer 'how is power arranged'—one operating inside the existing system, one re-founding it from an external blueprint.

cross_references.relation_type: 屡败重启与程序退出的对照
cross_references.description_zh: 曼德拉以屡败重启的信念杠杆熬过罗本岛（M-MAN 系列）；孙中山十次起义失败一朝功成，同样以信念杠杆对抗行动瘫痪（M-SYS-008）。两人共同示范：长期事业的第一资产是失败后的重启能力。
cross_references.description_en: Mandela endured Robben Island with a conviction lever for repeated defeats (M-MAN series); Sun Yat-sen failed ten uprisings before one succeeded, equally wielding a conviction lever against action paralysis (M-SYS-008). Both demonstrate that the first asset of a long cause is the capacity to restart after failure.

modes.domain_zh: 行动障碍的心理重置/知行关系
modes.domain_en: Psychological Reset of Action Barriers / Knowledge-Action Relation
modes.definition_zh: 孙中山面对的根本障碍不是敌人强大，而是『知之非艰，行之惟艰』这句古训造成的全民畏难心理：同志们把革命不成归咎于理想太高、行事太难，于是暮气沉沉、坐而论道。他的诊断是：把知行难度标反了——真知其实最难（人类花几千年才认识电、才造火车），而照着真知去行反而容易（『能知必能行』）。他不是靠励志口号劝人行动，而是重写行动的哲学前提：一旦认定『行』比『知』容易，畏难者就从『不敢做』转为『还没学懂』，行动的心理门槛被整体降维。方法上这意味着：当一个组织的普遍症状是光说不做时，先别造鞭子，先检查它的行动理论——很多『不敢行』的病根，是『以为知很容易、所以行才显得难』的认知标定错误；重置这组标定，比任何考核鞭策都更根本。
modes.definition_en: Sun Yat-sen's fundamental obstacle was not the strength of his enemies but the paralysis wrought by the ancient maxim 'knowing is not hard, doing is hard': comrades blamed failed revolutions on ideals being too lofty, sank into lethargy, and talked instead of acting. His diagnosis inverted the scale: true knowledge is the hardest thing (humanity needed millennia to understand electricity and build trains), while acting on true knowledge is comparatively easy—'once you can know, you can surely do.' He did not whip people into action with slogans; he rewrote the philosophical premise of action itself. Once 'doing' is seen as easier than 'knowing,' the hesitant shift from 'I dare not act' to 'I have not yet understood'—the psychological threshold of action drops wholesale. Methodologically: when an organization's systemic symptom is all talk and no action, do not first build whips; inspect its theory of action—much 'dare not act' is a miscalibration that takes knowing as easy and therefore doing as hard. Recalibrating that scale is more fundamental than any performance pressure.
modes.source_chapter: 《建国方略之一·孙文学说》第六章『能知必能行』：『中国近代之积弱不振……实为知之非艰行之惟艰一说误之也』；全书以饮食、用钱、作文等十证论证行易知难
modes.key_quote_zh: 吾心信其可行，则移山填海之难，终有成功之日；吾心信其不可行，则反掌折枝之易，亦无收效之期也。
modes.key_quote_en: If my heart believes a thing can be done, then even the difficulty of moving mountains and filling seas will one day be overcome; if my heart believes it cannot be done, then even the ease of turning over a palm or breaking a twig will yield nothing.
process_zh: 诊断组织『知而不行』的真实归因：是能力不足、激励不足，还是行动理论本身把行的难度标高了
收集『行易知难』的本地证据：找出那些做成了却说不清原理的事，与说得头头是道却从未做成的事
重写行动前提：把目标从『想清楚再做』改为『在行的过程中逼近真知』，允许以行养知
用一次小规模的『反畏难』实证闭环巩固新标定，让团队亲见行比想象的容易
process_en: Diagnose the real attribution of 'knowing but not doing': lack of ability, lack of incentive, or an action theory that has marked doing as too hard
Gather local evidence for doing-is-easy-knowing-is-hard: things accomplished without full theory, versus theories perfectly stated yet never executed
Rewrite the premise of action: shift from 'understand fully, then act' to 'approach true knowledge in the course of acting,' letting action feed knowledge
Consolidate the new calibration with one small counter-avoidance closed loop, letting the team see for themselves that doing is easier than feared
representative_cases_zh: 《孙文学说》以『饮食』为例：人人日日行之而无人尽知营养之理——证行不必待真知；以『用钱』为例：人人花钱而罕有人懂货币学——行的门槛远低于知的门槛
同盟会时期党人屡以『理想太高』劝阻起义，孙中山以知难行易说逐条驳斥，把屡败重构为『知未至而先行』的必要学费
王阳明『知行合一』的重定向：阳明说知而不行只是未知，孙中山进一步说正因真知极难，所以行反而是接近知的捷径
反例警示：同时期以『条件不成熟』为词而永远筹款的保皇派团体，始终停留在『先知后行』的旧标定里——标定不换，行动永不发生
representative_cases_en: In the Sun Wen Doctrine he used 'eating' as proof: everyone eats daily yet no one fully understands nutrition—doing does not wait for true knowledge; 'spending money': all spend, few grasp monetary theory—the threshold of doing is far below that of knowing

When Tongmenghui comrades repeatedly discouraged uprisings as 'ideals too lofty,' Sun rebutted point by point with knowing-is-hard-doing-is-easy, reframing defeats as necessary tuition paid when knowledge lags action

A redirection of Wang Yangming's 'unity of knowledge and action': Yangming held that knowing without doing is not yet knowing; Sun went further—precisely because true knowledge is so hard, acting is the shortcut toward it

Counterexample: reformist circles that eternally 'raised funds pending ripe conditions' stayed forever inside the old calibration of 'know first, act later'—without changing the calibration, action never occurs
modern_applications_zh: 创业团队执行瘫痪：先检查是否『要求完美论证才动手』，把 MVP 的哲学基础讲透再谈冲刺
组织变革：把『调研决策』流程改为『试点学习』流程，用行养知
个人学习：语言、编程等技能以『先做后懂』替代『先懂后做』
政策推广：与其反复论证，不如先立可逆小试点，让事实证明可行
modern_applications_en: Startup execution paralysis: check whether perfect analysis is demanded before acting; explain the philosophical basis of the MVP before sprints
Organizational change: convert 'research-then-decide' pipelines into 'pilot-then-learn' pipelines, letting action feed knowledge
Personal learning: for languages and coding, replace 'understand first, do later' with 'do first, understand sooner'
Policy rollout: instead of endless justification, launch small reversible pilots and let facts prove feasibility

modes.domain_zh: 目标分解/过渡阶段设计
modes.definition_zh: 辛亥革命后共和理想迅速变质为军阀政治，孙中山复盘得出的结论极为具体：错不在目标，而在把『军政一蹴而至宪政』——跳过了训练人民与养成自治能力的过渡期。他的解法是把终局目标拆成三个有明确进出标准的阶段：军政（以兵扫除障碍）、训政（派合格人员协助各县筹备自治，人口清查、土地测量、警卫道路、四权训练全部达标才算『完全自治之县』）、宪政（全省县自治完成始开宪政，全国过半省完成才颁宪法，国民政府届时解职还政于民）。关键在于他给的不是时间表而是验收标准——阶段推进以事实达标为准，不以宣布为准。方法上这意味着：宏大愿景的失败常因缺少『过渡态设计』；把终局拆成有可验证验收条件的阶段链，让每一步既有合法性又有退出条款，比空喊长期主义有效得多。
modes.definition_en: After the 1911 Revolution, the republican ideal rapidly decayed into warlord politics. Sun's post-mortem was precise: the error lay not in the goal but in leaping from military rule straight to constitutional government, skipping the transition needed to train the people and cultivate self-governance. His fix was to decompose the end state into three stages with explicit entry/exit criteria: military rule (clearing obstacles by force), tutelage (dispatching qualified personnel to help each county prepare self-government—census, land survey, policing and roads, training in the four direct powers—all met before a county counts as 'fully self-governing'), and constitutional government (a province enters only when all its counties qualify; the national constitution issues only when a majority of provinces qualify; the National Government then dissolves and returns power to an elected government). Crucially he gave acceptance criteria, not a timetable—stage advance by verified facts, not by declaration. Methodologically: grand visions usually fail from missing 'transitional-state design'; decomposing the endgame into a chain of stages with verifiable acceptance criteria—each step legitimate yet with an exit clause—beats empty long-termism.
modes.source_chapter: 《国民政府建国大纲》第十六至二十五条：军政-训政-宪政三期的进入条件、县自治验收标准与『授政于民选之政府』的退出条款；《中国革命史》论三期革命方略
modes.key_quote_zh: 宪法颁布之日，即为宪政告成之时……国民政府则于选举完毕之后三个月解职，而授政于民选之政府，是为建国之大功告成。
modes.key_quote_en: The day the constitution is promulgated is the day constitutional government is complete... and three months after the election, the National Government shall resign, handing power to the elected government—therein the great work of nation-building is done.
process_zh: 复盘失败：把『目标变质』归因到缺失的过渡环节，而非归因于目标本身或环境
把终局拆成阶段链，每一阶段写明：进入条件、任务清单、可核验的退出标准
给最后一阶段设计强制退出条款（谁到期必须交权、交给谁），防止过渡期自我永久化
以事实验收驱动推进，拒绝以宣布或纪念日驱动；未达标则停留并补课
process_en: Post-mortem the failure: attribute 'goal decay' to the missing transitional link, not to the goal itself or the environment
Decompose the endgame into a stage chain, each stage specifying entry conditions, task list, and verifiable exit criteria
Design a mandatory exit clause for the final stage (who must hand over power, to whom, by when) to prevent the transition from self-perpetuating
Advance by verified acceptance, never by proclamation or anniversaries; if criteria are unmet, hold and remediate
representative_cases_zh: 《建国大纲》规定县自治的验收清单（人口清查、土地测量、警卫、道路、四权训练、义务履行），达标方可自选县官议员——把『训政』从口号变成工程验收
孙中山明言辛亥教训：『由军政时期一蹴而至宪政时期，绝不予人民以养成自治能力之时间』，于是有假民治之名行专制之实的三种流弊
1928年后国民党以《训政纲领》进入训政，却无限期拖延宪政——反例警示：只借用了分期设计、删掉了退出条款的程序论，必然退化为过渡期的自我永久化
同一方法论反用：他在同盟会章程中亦以『军法之治-约法之治-宪法之治』分期，1905年即已成型，前后二十年迭代的是验收标准而非框架
representative_cases_en: The Fundamentals of National Reconstruction set a county self-government acceptance checklist (census, land survey, policing, roads, training in the four powers, duties fulfilled) before officials could be elected—turning 'tutelage' from slogan into engineering acceptance

Sun named the 1911 lesson explicitly: leaping from military rule straight to constitutional rule gave the people no time to build capacity for self-rule, producing three pathologies including despotism under democracy's name

After 1928 the KMT entered tutelage under the Tutelage Program yet indefinitely postponed constitutional rule—counterexample: borrowing the stage design while deleting the exit clause inevitably degenerates into self-perpetuating transition
The same method in reverse: his 1905 Tongmenghui charter already staged 'rule by military law, by covenant, by constitution'; twenty years of iteration refined the acceptance criteria, not the frame
modern_applications_zh: 转型项目分阶段治理：给每个阶段写『退出条款』，防止转型委员会变成永久机构
产品从 0 到 1 到 N：终局愿景拆为有验收标准的阶段，而不是只有一个大上线日
国际援助/制度移植：以能力验收（而非选举日历）决定移交节奏
个人大目标：为每个阶段定义『什么算完成』，拒绝用努力时长自欺
modern_applications_en: Phased transformation governance: write exit clauses per stage so transition committees do not become permanent bodies
Products from 0-to-1 to N: decompose the vision into stages with acceptance criteria instead of one big launch date
International aid / institutional transplant: let capability acceptance, not election calendars, set the handover pace
Personal grand goals: define 'what counts as done' per stage; refuse to self-deceive with hours invested

modes.domain_zh: 土地财政/增值收益分配
modes.domain_en: Land Finance / Distribution of Unearned Increment
modes.definition_zh: 孙中山观察到都市土地的增值主要来自公共建设与人口聚集（『坐享其成』），而非地主的经营，于是设计了一个四环节自洽闭环：规定地价（地主自报，政府照价征税、必要时照价收买——报低则税重、报高则被收买，使申报自动趋真）、照价征税、涨价归公、照价收买。妙处在机制互相咬合：收买权是申报环节的『验真器』，税是持有环节的『挤泡沫器』，涨价归公是分配环节的『公共回收器』——四个环节没有任何一个单独靠得住，合起来却让说谎无利可图。他刻意与没收式土改区分：不夺既有私产，只截取未来公共性增值，兼顾效率与公平。方法上这意味着：分配正义难题的解法常常不是『定谁多谁少』，而是设计一组互相制衡的程序，让每一方的最优策略恰好是讲真话。
modes.definition_en: Sun observed that urban land appreciation flows mainly from public works and population agglomeration—the owner 'reaps what others sow'—not from the landlord's effort. He therefore designed a four-clause self-consistent loop: declared value (the owner self-reports; the state taxes by declared value and may compulsorily purchase at that declared value—under-declaring brings heavier tax, over-declaring invites purchase, so truthful declaration becomes optimal), taxation by value, unearned increment to the public, and purchase at declared value. The elegance is the interlocking: the purchase right is the verifier of declaration, the tax is the bubble-squeezer of holding, and value capture is the public recycler of distribution—no single clause stands alone, yet together they make lying unprofitable. He deliberately distinguished this from confiscatory land reform: existing private property untouched, only future public-origin increment recaptured, reconciling efficiency and equity. Methodologically: distributive-justice problems are often solved not by decreeing who gets more, but by designing mutually checking procedures in which each party's optimal strategy is to tell the truth.
modes.source_chapter: 三民主义·民生主义第二讲论『规定地价、照价征税、照价收买、涨价归公』；同盟会誓词（1905）首纳『平均地权』
modes.key_quote_zh: 地价既由地主自定，则报高报低，两皆受其弊：报低者以重税，报高者任收买——故所报之价，必与真价相去不远。
modes.key_quote_en: Since the owner sets the price himself, declaring low or high both hurt him: low brings heavy tax, high invites purchase—so the declared value cannot stray far from the true one.
process_zh: 识别增值的真实来源：区分当事人投入创造的增值与外部性/公共投入造成的增值
设计申报机制，并给申报装上『验真器』（报低受罚、报高承担被收买风险的对称压力）
把公共来源的增值部分以税或分成形式回收，投入再造公共品，形成正循环
守住边界：只回收未来增值、不动既有合法所得——用『不追溯』换取制度通过的政治可行性
process_en: Identify the true source of appreciation: separate value created by the party's own investment from value created by externalities or public spending
Design a declaration mechanism and install its verifier (symmetric pressure: under-declaring taxed heavier, over-declaring exposed to purchase)
Recycle the public-origin share of appreciation via tax or revenue share, reinvesting it in public goods to form a positive loop
Hold the boundary: recapture only future increment, never touch existing lawful gains—trade non-retroactivity for political feasibility of the institution
representative_cases_zh: 同盟会誓词（1905）把『平均地权』与『驱除鞑虏』并列写入誓词——分配纲领从革命第一天就进入顶层设计，而非事后补丁
四大纲领的互锁设计：照价收买使地主不敢低报，照价征税使其不敢高报，两权相迫，申报价自动收敛于市价
与亨利·乔治单一税的承变关系：孙接受『土地增值社会化』的核心洞见，但加入照价收买这一中国式验真装置，比单一税多一层执行保险
反例警示：后来台湾实施『平均地权条例』取得涨价归公实绩，而大陆同期没收式土改虽快却伴随巨大动荡——同一目标，机制设计不同，代价迥异
representative_cases_en: The 1905 Tongmenghui oath placed 'equalizing land rights' alongside 'expelling the Tartars'—distribution entered top-level design on day one, not as an afterthought
The interlocking four clauses: purchase-at-declared-value deters under-reporting, value taxation deters over-reporting; the two pressures converge the declared price on the market price

Inheritance from Henry George's single tax: Sun accepted the core insight of socializing land-value gains but added purchase-at-declared-value, a Chinese-style verification device—an extra layer of enforcement insurance beyond the single tax

Counterexample: Taiwan's later Equalization of Land Rights Act realized value capture with modest disruption, while contemporaneous confiscatory land reform on the mainland, though fast, came with immense turmoil—same goal, different mechanism design, vastly different costs
modern_applications_zh: 城市土地增值税/ TOD 开发权捕获：公共基建带来的地价上涨按比例回收再投入轨交
数据要素分配：平台增值来自用户公共行为，可用『申报-审计-强制回购』闭环设计收益返还
知识产权职务发明：界定个人投入与组织平台增值的边界，只截取后者
任何申报制度的设计检查表：申报方说真话是否恰好是其最优策略？
modern_applications_en: Urban land-value tax / TOD development-right capture: recycle infrastructure-driven appreciation back into transit
Data-factor distribution: platform value arises from users' collective behavior; design a declare-audit-compulsory-buyback loop for revenue return
Employee inventions: demarcate personal contribution from organizational-platform increment; capture only the latter
A checklist for any declaration regime: is truth-telling precisely the declarer's optimal strategy?

modes.domain_zh: 国际资本动员/后发工业化
modes.definition_zh: 一战刚结束，孙中山『内审中国之情势，外察世界之潮流』，看到一组被所有人忽略的对偶：中国有亟待开发的资源与市场但缺资本，战后欧美有海量剩余资本与产能但缺出路。他的《实业计划》本质是一笔巨型套利设计——以国际共同开发的方式，把西方战时经济急需泄洪的资本，导入中国的铁路（十大系统）、三大世界级港口（北方/东方/南方大港）、矿业与衣食用工业，用交通带动实业『万端齐发』。他甚至论证这是『与国际资本家联手共同发展中国之利』的双赢，而非乞讨或出卖主权。其胆识在于：把中国定位为全球资本循环的接盘方而非单纯的受害者，主动设计接入方案。方法上这意味着：面对资源错配的两个世界，第三方的机会是设计『对接装置』——谁先画出可信的接口蓝图（路线、港口、偿付、治理），谁就赢得先手。
modes.definition_en: Just as the Great War ended, Sun Yat-sen, 'examining China's situation within and the world's currents without,' saw a pairing everyone else ignored: China had resources and markets awaiting development but lacked capital, while postwar Europe and America held vast surplus capital and capacity with nowhere to go. His International Development of China was at bottom a giant arbitrage design—channeling the flood of capital Western wartime economies urgently needed to discharge into China's ten railway systems, three world-class ports (Northern, Eastern, Southern Great Ports), mining, and the industries of clothing, food, and daily life, with transport leading industry to 'burst forth in ten thousand directions.' He even argued this was mutual gain—'developing China in common with international capital'—neither begging nor selling sovereignty. His audacity lay in positioning China as the receiving end of the global capital cycle rather than merely its victim, and proactively designing the interface. Methodologically: when two worlds hold mismatched resources, a third party's opportunity is to design the coupling device—whoever first draws a credible interface blueprint (routes, ports, repayment, governance) seizes the initiative.
modes.source_chapter: 《建国方略之二·实业计划》绪论与第一计划：论国际共同发展中国实业、三大港与十大铁路系统；《远东时报》1919 年英文原稿
modes.key_quote_zh: 发展中国工业，无论如何，必须进行。但其进行之方，将随西方文明之旧路而行乎？……不啻如哥伦布初由欧至美之海程……取一直捷方向，则路程短于前时数倍者。
modes.key_quote_en: The development of China's industry must proceed at all costs. But shall it follow the old road of Western civilization? ...like Columbus's first voyage from Europe to America... take the direct route and the distance shrinks manyfold.
process_zh: 扫描两端的错配：谁有不可储存的剩余（资本/产能/注意力），谁有未被开发的需求（资源/市场/人才）
把自己定位为对接方而非乞求方：设计可信接口——项目清单、收益模式、偿付与治理结构
以杠杆资产排序：先建能放大其余一切的节点（交通、港口、能源），再铺面
管理主权与信任风险：坚持开放多边而非单独抵押，用蓝图的可验证性换资金方信任
process_en: Scan both ends for mismatch: who holds perishable surplus (capital, capacity, attention), who holds undeveloped demand (resources, markets, talent)
Position yourself as the coupler, not the beggar: design a credible interface—project list, revenue model, repayment and governance structure
Sequence by leverage assets: first build the nodes that amplify everything else (transport, ports, energy), then spread wide
Manage sovereignty and trust risk: insist on open multilateralism over single-creditor pledges; trade blueprint verifiability for financiers' trust
representative_cases_zh: 《实业计划》规划十大铁路系统与北方大港：以直隶湾为出海口把西北内陆接入全球贸易——把『欠发达』重述为『未接入』
一战后的特殊窗口：欧美钢铁、机车、工程产能严重过剩，孙在停战仅数月内即成稿——对错配窗口的时点把握是其方法论核心
胡适的平反：时人讥为『孙大炮』狂想，胡适却赞『盲人瞎马的时代有此远大计划，为国内最可使人满意之事』——对接蓝图的价值常先于其可行性被感知
反例警示：书中多数项目因军阀割据与列强冷淡而未及实施——对接设计若无政治统一的前提托底，蓝图再精也只能待时；百年后青藏铁路与三大港口带动的区域发展反向验证了其框架
representative_cases_en: The Plan's ten railway systems and the Northern Great Port: wiring the northwestern interior into global trade via the Bohai approaches—reframing 'underdeveloped' as 'not yet connected'

The post-WWI window: European and American steel, locomotive, and engineering capacity badly oversupplied; Sun finished the manuscript within months of the armistice—timing the mismatch window is the heart of the method

Hu Shi's rehabilitation: contemporaries mocked 'Grand Cannon Sun,' but Hu praised 'the most satisfying thing in this blind-men-on-blind-horses era'—an interface blueprint's value is sensed before its feasibility is proven

Counterexample: most projects lapsed amid warlord fragmentation and Great-Power indifference—without political unity as collateral, however fine the blueprint must wait its hour; a century later the Qinghai-Tibet railway and port-led regional growth retro-validated the framework
modern_applications_zh: 一带一路与基建输出：把过剩产能对接他国未接入市场，本质是同一方法论的国家版
区域经济开发：先画『接口蓝图』（枢纽、走廊、结算），再谈招商引资
个人职业错配套利：把一方过剩技能对接另一方稀缺需求，做设计接口的人
窗口期纪律：错配红利有时效，蓝图必须先于窗口成熟
modern_applications_en: Belt-and-Road style infrastructure export: coupling surplus capacity to unconnected markets—the national-scale version of the same method
Regional development: draw the interface blueprint (hubs, corridors, settlement) before courting investors
Personal career arbitrage: couple one side's surplus skills to the other's scarce demand—be the interface designer
Window discipline: mismatch dividends expire; the blueprint must mature before the window closes

modes.definition_zh: 孙中山不把西方三权分立当作终点，而当作一份待修补的缺陷清单：议会控制官员任免则产生无能的『政客公仆』，监督权寄生在立法权内则酿成议会专制——他逐条找到病灶，再从中国科举与御史传统中移植药方，把考选权、纠察权从行政、立法两权中拆出，构成五权；又把国家权力切成两层：人民握选举、罢免、创制、复决四权（政权，管政府），政府握行政、立法、司法、考试、监察五权（治权，做事能）。这是『诊断—移植—重构』的完整链条：先承认舶来制度有流弊，再从本土制度库找互补件，最后重组为整体框架。方法上这意味着：面对一套强大但带病的主流方案，全盘照搬与全盘拒斥都是偷懒；正确姿势是逐条归因其缺陷、跨文明寻找已被验证的替代件、重新合成一个更完整的版本。
modes.definition_en: Sun refused to treat Western separation of three powers as a terminus, treating it instead as a defect list awaiting repair: when the legislature controls appointments, it breeds incompetent 'politician-servants'; when oversight nests inside legislative power, it breeds parliamentary tyranny. He attributed each flaw, then transplanted remedies from China's examination and censorial traditions—splitting examination power out of the executive and supervision power out of the legislature to form five branches; and he sliced state power into two layers: the people hold four powers (election, recall, initiative, referendum—powers over government), while government holds five (administrative, legislative, judicial, examination, supervisory—powers to govern). This is a complete diagnose-transplant-recompose chain: admit the imported system's pathologies, find proven complements in the indigenous institutional library, and recombine into a more complete framework. Methodologically: facing a dominant but diseased mainstream design, wholesale copying and wholesale rejection are both lazy; the right posture is flaw-by-flaw attribution, cross-civilizational sourcing of validated substitutes, and resynthesis into a fuller version.
modes.source_chapter: 1906 年与该鲁学尼谈五权宪法；三民主义·民权主义第五、六讲论权能区分：『人民是工程师，政府是机器』；五权宪法讲演
modes.key_quote_zh: 我们现在要集合中外的精华，防止一切的流弊……采用外国的行政权、立法权、司法权，加入中国的考试权和监察权，连成一个很好的完璧。
modes.key_quote_en: We must now gather the essence of China and the West and guard against every abuse... adopt the foreign executive, legislative, and judicial powers, add China's examination and supervisory powers, and join them into one perfect whole.
process_zh: 把权威方案当作缺陷清单逐条体检：每一项设计追问『它在什么条件下会走向反面』
为每个已确诊的缺陷跨文明寻找已验证的互补件（本民族或他文明的成熟装置）
重组框架：让新增部件与原部件形成制衡而非叠加，重新定义权限边界
标注自己尚未想透的部分（孙自承五权『详细条理……要望大众尽力研究』），留出迭代接口
process_en: Treat the authoritative design as a defect list and audit it item by item: for each element ask 'under what conditions does it turn into its opposite'
For each confirmed defect, source a validated complementary component across civilizations (native or foreign, wherever proven)
Recompose the framework so new parts check rather than stack upon the original ones, redrawing boundaries of authority
Flag the parts not yet thought through (Sun himself admitted the five powers' 'detailed structure' awaited collective research), leaving interfaces for iteration
representative_cases_zh: 从御史制度提炼监察权、从科举提炼考试权——两项被革命话语否定的『帝制遗产』被反转为宪制资产，是跨文明移植的教科书案例
权能区分的比喻：人民是 owner（管人），政府是 engineer（管事）——把『人民无能』与『政府无能』两类病分开诊断，避免用削权治低效
1924 年国民党一大后他仍向党员直言五权的详细结构尚待研究——承认设计半成品比伪装完成态更能吸引协作者
反例警示：民国初年照搬三权的《临时约法》在议会滥权与府院相争中迅速失灵——主流方案的已知流弊若不预先修补，移植之日即病变之时
representative_cases_en: Distilling supervisory power from the censorial system and examination power from the imperial examination—two 'imperial legacies' negated by revolutionary discourse, reversed into constitutional assets: a textbook case of cross-civilizational transplant

The powers-split metaphor: the people are the owner (hiring and firing), government the engineer (doing the work)—separating 'people incapacity' from 'government incapacity' avoids curing inefficiency by stripping authority

Even after the 1924 KMT reorganization he told party members the five powers' detailed structure awaited research—admitting a half-finished design attracts collaborators better than feigning completion

Counterexample: the Provisional Constitution of the early Republic, copying three powers wholesale, failed rapidly amid legislative abuse and executive-legislative deadlock—an imported design's known pathologies, unpatched, detonate on arrival
modern_applications_zh: 公司治理补漏：董事会之外独立设审计与提名委员会，本质是五权思路的现代企业版
开源治理：模仿成熟项目结构时，逐条审计其已知痛点并补自定义机制
产品借鉴：竞品功能清单不照抄，先归因其差评集中的模块再重组
制度移植评估表：列出原产地已暴露的流弊清单，逐项写明本地方案
modern_applications_en: Corporate-governance patching: independent audit and nomination committees beside the board—the five-branch idea in modern corporate form
Open-source governance: when mimicking a mature project's structure, audit its known pain points and add custom mechanisms
Product borrowing: never copy a rival's feature list; attribute its worst-reviewed modules first, then recombine
Institutional-transplant checklist: enumerate pathologies already exposed at origin, and state the local remedy for each

modes.domain_zh: 民主的程序化训练/会议技术
modes.domain_en: Procedural Training for Democracy / Meeting Craft
modes.definition_zh: 孙中山观察到中国人『一盘散沙』的要害不在缺乏民主理想，而在不会开一个有秩序的会：没有议事规则，集会即散伙，表决即纷争。他的《民权初步》把罗伯特议事规则整本翻译改造，逐条规定动议、附议、发言、表决的程序，并把练习开会定义为『民权之第一步』——民主不是被颁布的，是被操演出来的。这本书在《建国方略》中列为『社会建设』，与心理建设、物质建设并列：他把『会开好』看得与铁路港口同等重要。方法上这意味着：任何需要集体协作的复杂目标，其瓶颈常是一个被精英轻视的基础技艺；把该技艺写成可反复操演的规程并强迫练习，比呼吁价值观有效一个数量级。
modes.definition_en: Sun observed that the crux of China being 'a sheet of loose sand' lay not in lacking democratic ideals but in not knowing how to hold an orderly meeting: without rules of procedure, assemblies dissolve and votes become quarrels. His Manual of Parliamentary Procedure translated and adapted Robert's Rules clause by clause—motions, seconds, debate, voting—and defined practicing meetings as 'the first step of civil rights': democracy is not promulgated but rehearsed. The book stands in the Fundamentals of National Reconstruction as 'social construction,' ranked alongside psychological and material construction: he rated 'holding meetings well' as equal in importance to railways and ports. Methodologically: for any complex goal requiring collective action, the bottleneck is often a basic craft despised by elites; codifying that craft into a drillable procedure and forcing practice beats exhorting values by an order of magnitude.
modes.source_chapter: 《建国方略之一·民权初步》自序：『民权何由而发达？则从固结人心、纠合群力始……集会则其第一步也』；全书对动议-附议-讨论-表决的全规程
modes.key_quote_zh: 民权何由而发达？则从固结人心、纠合群力始。而欲固结人心、纠合群力，又非从集会不为功。是集会者，实为民权发达之第一步。
modes.key_quote_en: By what does civil rights develop? It begins with binding hearts and combining forces. To bind hearts and combine forces, nothing serves but assembling—and the assembly is truly the first step of civil rights.
process_zh: 识别集体行动的最小可训练单元（对孙中山是会议；对现代团队可能是站会、代码评审、复盘）
为该单元引入或编写成文规程，细到发言顺序、时限、表决方式都可机械执行
把规程执行本身设为训练科目：反复操演、指定纠察角色、容忍初期形式主义的笨拙
以操演熟练度而非理念认同度作为能力验收标准
process_en: Identify the smallest trainable unit of collective action (for Sun, the meeting; for modern teams, standups, code review, retrospectives)
Introduce or write a written procedure for that unit, detailed enough that speaking order, time limits, and voting modes are mechanically executable
Make executing the procedure itself a training subject: repeated drills, designated floor-watchers, tolerance for early ritualistic clumsiness
Accept drill proficiency, not ideological agreement, as the acceptance standard of capability
representative_cases_zh: 《民权初步》逐字教如何附议、如何打断、如何平息纷争——一本『怎么开会』的书被列为建国方略之首，是对『民主从开会学起』的极致践行
兴中会与同盟会的入会宣誓仪式：把抽象纲领转化为个人当众可执行的誓词行为——组织凝聚力也被程序化为仪式操演
护法运动中非常国会的运作经验让他确认：有议员无议事能力，共和国照样空转
反例警示：民初国会开议数年而议事规则形同虚设，议员以互殴与流会上头条——没有操演的民主理念只是修辞
representative_cases_en: The Manual teaches clause by clause how to second, how to interrupt, how to quell disorder—a book on 'how to hold a meeting' ranked first in the nation-building program, the extreme form of 'democracy learned through meetings'
The oath rituals of the Xingzhonghui and Tongmenghui: converting abstract programs into individually performable public vows—organizational cohesion, too, proceduralized as ritual drill
Experience in the Extraordinary Parliament during the Constitutional Protection Movement confirmed: with legislators but no procedural capacity, a republic idles just the same

Counterexample: the early-Republic parliament sat for years with rules of order honored only in the breach, its headline brawls and boycotts proving that democratic ideals without drill are mere rhetoric
modern_applications_zh: 敏捷团队：把站会/评审写成 30 秒内可判断合规与否的规程，并周期性演练
社区治理：业委会、DAO 的表决规则文档化，配套『议事纠察』角色
教学：课堂讨论规则训练先于内容教学
组织文化检查：宣称的价值观里有没有一条落到了可操演的会议规程？
modern_applications_en: Agile teams: write standups and reviews as procedures judgeable in thirty seconds for compliance, and drill them periodically
Community governance: codify voting rules for boards and DAOs, with a designated floor-watch role
Teaching: train classroom-discussion rules before content
Culture check: among your professed values, is even one embodied in a drillable meeting procedure?

modes.domain_zh: 承诺装置/组织认同仪式
modes.definition_zh: 孙中山是中国政治宣誓制度的开创者：兴中会盟书、同盟会誓词、中华革命党按指模立誓、临时大总统向国民就职宣誓——他把西方宪政的宣誓传统移植进来，并做了创造性转换：传统中国只有向天发誓（对神负责），他改成向国民宣誓（对人民负责），『数千年来王侯将相自命天子，哪有对国民宣誓』。誓词的功能是把不可见的忠诚变成可见的公共行为：签押、按模、当众宣读，使背叛需要付出双倍成本（事实背叛+仪式背叛）。方法上这意味着：组织的关键承诺应设计成公开、具名、有仪式重量的行为装置——承诺的成本越显性，履约的社会压力越强；对神发誓是对不确定观众演讲，对人宣誓是把观众变成证人。
modes.definition_en: Sun Yat-sen was the founder of China's political oath system: the Xingzhonghui covenant, the Tongmenghui oath, the Chinese Revolutionary Party's fingerprinted pledge, the Provisional President's inaugural oath to the nation. He transplanted the Western constitutional oath tradition with a creative transformation: traditional China swore only to Heaven (accountable to gods), while he swore to the nation (accountable to the people)—'for millennia emperors and generals styled themselves Sons of Heaven; who ever swore to the citizens?' The oath converts invisible loyalty into visible public action: signing, fingerprinting, reading aloud—so betrayal now costs double (factual plus ritual betrayal). Methodologically: an organization's critical commitments should be designed as public, named, ritually weighty acts—the more visible the cost of pledging, the stronger the social pressure to honor it; swearing to gods is a speech to an uncertain audience, while swearing to people turns the audience into witnesses.
modes.source_chapter: 兴中会盟书（1894『倘有二心，神明鉴察』→同盟会誓词『矢信矢忠，有始有卒，倘有食言，任众处罚』）；《临时大总统就职宣言》；《中华革命党总章》第七条
modes.key_quote_zh: 矢信矢忠，有始有卒，倘有食言，任众处罚。
modes.key_quote_en: Faithful and true, from beginning to end; should I break my word, let the assembly punish me.
process_zh: 识别需要强化承诺的关键关系（成员对纲领、领袖对民众、伙伴对合作）
把承诺写成第一人称、具名、可指认的文本，规定违约的社会后果（『任众处罚』）
设计有身体记忆的仪式环节（签署、按模、举手、当众诵读）——让承诺通过身体刻入
把宣誓从入会环节扩展为权力交接环节：掌权者向被治理者宣誓，反转权威方向
process_en: Identify the critical commitments needing reinforcement (member-to-program, leader-to-public, partner-to-partnership)
Write the pledge as first-person, named, attributable text with stipulated social consequences for breach ('let the assembly punish me')
Design ritual elements with body memory (signing, fingerprinting, raised hand, recitation aloud)—let commitment be engraved through the body
Extend oath-taking from membership to power transfer: the ruler swears to the governed, inverting the direction of authority
representative_cases_zh: 1894 兴中会盟书尚是『神明鉴察』的传统格式，1905 同盟会誓词已改为『任众处罚』——五年间完成从对神发誓到对众负责的转换，誓词文本本身记录了政治哲学的跃迁
1912 临时大总统就职向国民宣誓，首开元首对民宣誓先河，后经《宣誓条例》（1930）制度化
中华革命党要求按指模、『服从文一人』的极端化版本——反例警示：承诺装置过度人格化会从凝聚工具异化为帮派规训，仪式的正当性取决于其对谁负责
黄兴因拒绝按指模而与孙分道——同一仪式对不同人的成本感知不同，强承诺装置天然筛选同伴也排挤伙伴
representative_cases_en: The 1894 Xingzhonghui covenant still bore the traditional 'witnessed by the gods'; the 1905 Tongmenghui oath already read 'let the assembly punish me'—in five years the shift from swearing to gods to answering to the assembly, the text itself recording a leap in political philosophy
The 1912 Provisional President's inaugural oath to the nation inaugurated heads-of-state swearing to citizens, later institutionalized by the 1930 Oath Regulations

The Chinese Revolutionary Party's fingerprinting and 'obedience to Sun alone'—counterexample: over-personalized commitment devices degenerate from cohesion tools into gang discipline; a ritual's legitimacy depends on to whom it answers
Huang Xing parted ways with Sun over refusing to fingerprint—the same ritual carries different costs for different people; strong commitment devices naturally filter allies and squeeze partners
modern_applications_zh: 开源项目：CONTRIBUTING 承诺+公开行为准则，违约走公示流程
合作与融资：把口头共识升级为具名签署的谅解备忘录，仪式感即信用
个人自律：公开立誓（社交媒体、社群）利用观众压力做承诺装置
组织入职：让新成员向服务对象（而非仅向老板）做服务宣誓
modern_applications_en: Open source: contributing pledges plus a public code of conduct with publicized breach procedures
Partnership and financing: upgrade verbal consensus to signed, named memoranda—the ritual is the credit
Personal discipline: public vows (social media, communities) using audience pressure as a commitment device
Onboarding: have new members swear service to those served, not merely to the boss

modes.domain_zh: 长期挫败下的动员/叙事重构
modes.domain_en: Mobilization under Chronic Defeat / Narrative Reframing
modes.definition_zh: 从 1895 广州起义到 1911 武昌，孙中山经手或遥控的起义十连败，经费耗散、同志离散、舆论讥其为『孙大炮』。他没有把失败叙事消化为『时机未到』的犬儒，也没有把希望押在孤注一掷上，而是维持一个反直觉的双层结构：战略上承认十败并系统复盘（经费、组织、策反对象逐次换轨），心理上却向组织持续供给『终有成功之日』的信念——『既不可以失败而灰心，亦不能以困难而缩步』。他真正的高杠杆动作是把革命主体持续换血：从会党到新军到华侨再到联俄容共后的工农，每次主力失败就更换动力源，而非更换目标。方法上这意味着：长期事业失败的复利不是来自目标错误，而是来自动力源耗尽；区分『目标不可改』与『载体必须换』，失败每发生一次就更换一次执行载体，让目标吃掉失败而不是被失败吃掉。
modes.definition_en: From the 1895 Guangzhou uprising to Wuchang in 1911, the uprisings Sun directed or remote-controlled lost ten straight: funds dissipated, comrades scattered, the press mocked 'Grand Cannon Sun.' He neither digested the defeats into the cynicism of 'the hour has not come' nor staked everything on one desperate throw; instead he maintained a counter-intuitive two-layer structure: strategically he acknowledged all ten defeats and post-mortemed them systematically (funds, organization, and targets of subversion shifted round by round), while psychologically he kept supplying the organization with the conviction that 'the day of final success will come'—'neither lose heart in failure nor shrink at difficulty.' His true high-leverage move was continuously transfusing the revolutionary body: from secret societies to the new army, to overseas Chinese, and after the 1924 alliance with Russia and admission of Communists, to workers and peasants—each time the main force failed he swapped the power source, never the goal. Methodologically: the compound interest of long-enterprise failure comes not from wrong goals but from exhausted power sources; separate 'the goal must not change' from 'the vehicle must change,' swapping the executing vehicle with each failure so the goal devours defeats rather than being devoured by them.
modes.source_chapter: 《建国方略》自序论革命失败与心理建设之必要；1928 年前历次起义复盘（惠州、萍浏醴、黄花岗等）；民元后『第二次革命』至护法运动的三度重启
modes.key_quote_zh: 既不可以失败而灰心，亦不能以困难而缩步，精神贯注，猛力向前，应乎世界进步之潮流……则终有最后成功之一日。
modes.key_quote_en: Neither lose heart in failure nor shrink at difficulty; pour in spirit and press forward mightily, riding the world's current of progress... and the day of final success shall surely come.
process_zh: 把失败逐次归因到载体层（谁去做、用什么资源、在哪个战场），严禁归因到目标层
为下一次尝试系统性更换动力源：新人群、新资源、新盟友，而非同源加码
维持双轨话语：对内复盘诚实到残酷，对外信念供给稳定到恒定
设『重启仪式』：每次大败后重组组织名义（兴中会→同盟会→国民党→中华革命党→中国国民党），用新名义切割旧负债
process_en: Attribute each failure, round by round, to the vehicle layer (who executes, with what resources, on which battlefield); forbid attribution to the goal layer
Systematically swap the power source for the next attempt: new constituencies, resources, allies—never same-source double-down
Run dual-track discourse: post-mortems internally honest to the point of brutality; conviction externally supplied with unwavering constancy

Institute a reboot ritual: reconstitute the organization under a new name after each major defeat (Xingzhonghui to Tongmenghui to KMT to Chinese Revolutionary Party to reorganized KMT), shedding legacy liabilities with the new name
representative_cases_zh: 黄花岗之役几乎损失全部骨干后，孙中山并未收缩，反而认定『愈挫愈奋』并将策反对象转向新军与武昌——次年武昌首义成功，十败的复盘直接喂养了第十一胜
组织五次更名重组（兴中会 1894→同盟会 1905→国民党 1912→中华革命党 1914→中国国民党 1919）：每次重组伴随章程、誓词与依靠对象的更换，失败负债不带入新主体
1924 联俄容共：主力与经费枯竭时引入苏俄援助并吸纳共产党人入伍——动力源换血的最后一击，也是争议最大的开关
反例警示：同代革命者多以一次大败即心灰退出或转入暗杀式孤注——只换情绪不换动力源，失败即复利
representative_cases_en: After the Huanghuang uprising nearly wiped out the cadre, Sun did not retrench; he shifted subversion toward the new army and Wuchang—next year Wuchang rose, the post-mortems of ten defeats feeding the eleventh victory

Five reconstitutions of the organization (1894 Xingzhonghui, 1905 Tongmenghui, 1912 KMT, 1914 Chinese Revolutionary Party, 1919 reorganized KMT): each brought new charter, oath, and constituency, leaving failure liabilities outside the new body
The 1924 alliance with Soviet Russia and admission of Communists: with the main force and funds exhausted, a last transfusion—the highest-leverage and most contested switch of all
Counterexample: contemporaries who quit in despair or pivoted to lone-assassin terrorism after one great defeat—swapping moods but not power sources, failure compounds
modern_applications_zh: 创业多次 pivot：目标（使命）钉死，产品、渠道、客群随失败逐次更换
科研长跑：课题主线不动，技术路线随阴性结果换轨
个人生涯：把『我失败了』重写为『第 N 载体失败了』，为下一载体列出换血清单
团队士气管理：复盘纪要与动员讲话分开写，禁止互相污染
modern_applications_en: Repeated startup pivots: nail the mission; swap product, channel, and segment with each failure
The long research race: keep the thesis, rotate the technical route on negative results
Personal career: rewrite 'I failed' as 'vehicle N failed,' and draft a transfusion list for vehicle N+1
Team morale: write post-mortems and pep talks as separate documents; never let them contaminate each other

modes.domain_zh: 过渡期权威设计/主义治国
modes.domain_en: Transitional Authority Design / Governing by Doctrine
modes.definition_zh: 孙中山的『以党治国』常被误读为党阀专制，其原始设计其实是一个有方向的托管结构：『以党治国并非用本党党员治国，是用本党的主义治国』——党是训政期代人民掌权的保姆，其正当性来自主义的正确与还政的承诺，且按革命程序论，训政有验收标准与强制退出条款。他把『党』定义为先知先觉者的训练机构而非利益集团：党的任务是训练人民行使四权，练成即交权。这个设计的致命脆弱在于：退出条款依赖党的自觉，一旦继任者只继承『党治』而不继承『还政』，托管就退化为永久占领——1928 年后的史实证明了这一点。方法上这意味着：任何『我先代管、好了还你』的权力托管设计，其成败不在托管者的能力而在退出机制的可执行性；设计托管时，必须把还政的验收标准与违约成本写在托管成立的同时，而非事后补充。
modes.definition_en: Sun's 'governing the state through the party' is often misread as party bossism, but its original design was a directed trusteeship: 'governing through the party means not governing through party members but governing through the party's doctrine'—the party is the nanny holding power in the people's stead during tutelage, its legitimacy resting on the doctrine's correctness and the promise to return power; and by the revolutionary program, tutelage carries acceptance criteria and a mandatory exit clause. He defined the party as a training body of the awakened, not an interest group: its task is to train the people to exercise the four powers, surrendering power once the training is done. The design's fatal fragility: the exit clause depends on the party's self-restraint—once successors inherit 'party rule' without inheriting 'return of power,' trusteeship decays into permanent occupation, as post-1928 history proved. Methodologically: for any 'I'll hold it in trust and hand it back when ready' design of power, success lies not in the trustee's competence but in the enforceability of the exit; write the return-of-power acceptance criteria and breach costs at the moment the trust is created, never as an afterthought.
modes.source_chapter: 1924 年关于『以党治国』演说：『是用本党的主义治国』；《建国大纲》训政条款与『授政于民选之政府』；国民党一大改组文件
modes.key_quote_zh: 以党治国并不是用本党的党员治国，是用本党的主义治国。
modes.key_quote_en: Governing the state through the party means not governing through party members but governing through the party's doctrine.
process_zh: 论证托管的必要性与期限性：为何现在必须代管、代管到什么标准为止
把托管正当性锚定在可检验的主义/章程上，而非个人权威上——被继承的应是文本
同时写死还政的验收标准与违约的社会成本（对内党章、对外宣言双轨锁定）
设计托管者自身受训练的机制：训人者先受宪制约束，防止双标
process_en: Argue the necessity and temporariness of trusteeship: why holding power now is unavoidable, and to what standard it must end
Anchor the trusteeship's legitimacy to a testable doctrine or charter, not personal authority—what gets inherited should be the text
Simultaneously lock the acceptance criteria for returning power and the social cost of breach (dual-track: internal charter, external declaration)
Build a mechanism by which the trustee itself is trained: those who tutor others must first submit to constitutional constraints, preventing double standards
representative_cases_zh: 孙定义训政期党的工作是派『训练考试合格之员』到各县教人民用四权——党的 KPI 是学员毕业，不是政权巩固
《建国大纲》写明国民政府『于选举完毕之后三个月解职』——托管者的解职日期先于其执政被写下
1924 改组：引入苏俄式党机器与纪律，使『主义治国』的组织载体骤然强化——但极强的组织力也预埋了退出条款失灵的风险
反例警示：1928《训政纲领》接管政权后，训政无限延长、宪政一拖再拖——只继承托管、不继承还政的程序论，是托管设计最常见也最致命的遗产篡改
representative_cases_en: Sun defined the party's tutelage task as sending 'trained and examined personnel' to the counties to teach the people the four powers—the party's KPI is its pupils' graduation, not regime consolidation
The Fundamentals stipulate the National Government 'shall resign three months after the election concludes'—the trustee's resignation date was written before its term began

The 1924 reorganization: importing a Soviet-style party machine and discipline abruptly strengthened the organizational vehicle of 'governing by doctrine'—but that very strength pre-loaded the risk of exit-clause failure

Counterexample: after the 1928 Tutelage Program seized power, tutelage extended indefinitely and constitutional rule kept slipping— inheriting the trust while amending away the return clause is the most common and most fatal falsification of a trusteeship design
modern_applications_zh: 创始人交接：把公司价值观与治理条款写成文本，创始人离开时被继承的是章程而非人
过渡管理/托管账户：设立时即写死移交条件与触发日期，拒绝『到时候再说』
平台治理：监管沙盒的退出标准与平台自营边界同时立法
代理权力审计：检查任何代管结构里『还权条款』是否与授权条款同等坚硬
modern_applications_en: Founder succession: codify values and governance as text—what is inherited at departure is the charter, not the person
Transition management / escrow: fix handover conditions and trigger dates at creation; refuse 'we'll see when the time comes'
Platform governance: legislate sandbox exit criteria and the platform's self-preferencing boundary simultaneously
Delegated-power audit: check whether the return-of-power clause in any custodial structure is as hard as the grant-of-power clause

modes.domain_zh: 国家建设的总体规划/多轨并行
modes.domain_en: Master Planning for Nation-Building / Multi-Track Parallelism
modes.definition_zh: 《建国方略》的结构本身就是方法论：心理建设（孙文学说——改造人不敢想）、物质建设（实业计划——改造国无所有）、社会建设（民权初步——改造人不会合）三轨并列。孙中山的独特处在于他认定革命的三类瓶颈属于不同层级：心（信念与畏难）、物（资本与基建）、群（协作规程），任何单轨突进都会被其余两轨拖回原点——所以三轨必须同时施工。他把『想、建、合』当作同等重要的大工程，这在『实业救国』与『主义救国』各执一端的时代是罕见的总体设计观。方法上这意味着：面对复杂系统的转型，先做瓶颈层级分类（心理层/物质层/协作层），诊断哪一层最短，再按最短板排施工顺序，且三轨蓝图要一次画全、分期施工——只画一轨的蓝图再精美也是残图。
modes.definition_en: The very structure of the Fundamentals of National Reconstruction is a methodology: psychological construction (the Sun Wen Doctrine—rebuilding what people dare not think), material construction (the Industrial Plan—rebuilding what the nation lacks), and social construction (the Manual of Parliamentary Procedure—rebuilding how people combine). Sun's singular insight was that revolution's bottlenecks sit on different levels—mind (belief and the fear of difficulty), matter (capital and infrastructure), group (procedures of cooperation)—and a breakthrough on any single track gets dragged back to zero by the other two; hence all three must be under construction simultaneously. In an age split between 'saving the nation through industry' and 'saving it through doctrine,' treating think, build, and combine as coequal grand projects was a rare total-design view. Methodologically: for complex-system transformation, first classify bottleneck levels (psychological / material / collaborative), diagnose the shortest plank, sequence construction by the shortest plank—and draw all tracks' blueprints in full at once, building in phases; a blueprint with one track omitted, however elegant, is a partial map.
modes.source_chapter: 《建国方略》全书结构：孙文学说（心理建设）+ 实业计划（物质建设）+ 民权初步（社会建设）；《三民主义》讲演中民族/民权/民生的三民并行结构
modes.key_quote_zh: 何为建设？心理建设、物质建设、社会建设三者并举，缺一不可。
modes.key_quote_en: What is construction? Psychological, material, and social construction advanced together—none can be spared.
process_zh: 给系统的瓶颈做层级分类：哪些卡在信念与叙事（心），哪些卡在资源与基建（物），哪些卡在协作规程（群）
为每一层各画一张可施工蓝图，且三张蓝图一次画全、互相引用
按当前最短板排序施工，但保持三轨都有最小进展量，防止单轨突进后被拖回
设跨轨验收节点：心轨的信念进步需以物轨/群轨的可验证产出为证，防止口号空转
process_en: Classify the system's bottlenecks by level: which jam at belief and narrative (mind), which at resources and infrastructure (matter), which at collaborative procedure (group)
Draw a buildable blueprint per level, all three at once, cross-referencing one another
Sequence construction by the current shortest plank while keeping a minimum rate of progress on all three tracks, preventing single-track sprints from being dragged back
Set cross-track acceptance nodes: progress on the mind track must be evidenced by verifiable output on the matter and group tracks, so slogans cannot idle
representative_cases_zh: 一本《建国方略》三件事：写哲学（知难行易）、画铁路港口图、教开会规矩——作者视三者同为『建设』，这本身就是对『蓝图必须三维同画』的示范
三民主义同构：民族（独立）、民权（制度）、民生（分配）三轨并行，1924 年讲演十六讲逐轨展开又互相引用
黄花岗后的转向：败于武装即补心轨（孙文学说写于败后低潮期）与物轨（实业计划起草于流亡），用另两轨的推进维持总攻势
反例警示：清末『实业救国』单轨突进毁于制度崩塌，民初『约法救国』单轨空转毁于无物可治——任何一轨独进的历史样本都以回撤收场
representative_cases_en: One book, three projects: writing philosophy (knowing-is-hard-doing-is-easy), drawing railways and ports, teaching meeting rules—the author counts all three as 'construction,' itself a demonstration that blueprints must be drawn in three dimensions at once
The isomorphic Three Principles: nationality (independence), civil rights (institution), livelihood (distribution) in parallel, expanded across sixteen 1924 lectures that cross-reference one another

The post-Huanghuang pivot: defeated in arms, he fed the mind track (the Doctrine, written in the trough) and the matter track (the Industrial Plan, drafted in exile), sustaining the general offensive through the other two

Counterexample: late-Qing 'save the nation by industry' single-track progress collapsed with the institutions; the early-Republic 'save it by constitutional law' idled with nothing to govern—every single-track historical sample ends in retreat
modern_applications_zh: 组织转型三维诊断：同时盘点文化叙事（心）、系统与资金（物）、流程与会议（群）的短板
个人大转型：心态、技能资产、协作网络三线并行排期
